description: Compares two to five Portuguese municipalities side by side, with the same figures for each as `municipality_stats`. Use it when choosing between places; for a single municipality use `municipality_stats`, and for the areas inside one city `where_to_live`. Names that point at the same municipality count once, and fewer than two distinct ones are refused (bad_count). One unknown or ambiguous name refuses the whole comparison.

language.description: Language of the page links and labels; the text summary and field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

municipalities.description: Two to five municipality names or codes

name: compare_municipalities

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Compare 2 to 5 Portuguese municipalities
